<body class="" style=""><vsc-controller class="vsc-controller vsc-nosource" style="top: 0px; left: 0px; position: absolute !important; z-index: 9999999 !important;"><template shadowrootmode="open"><style>
      * {
        line-height: 1.8em;
        font-family: sans-serif;
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      
      :host(:hover) #controls {
        display: inline-block;
      }
      
      /* Hide shadow DOM content for different hiding scenarios */
      :host(.vsc-hidden) #controller,
      :host(.vsc-nosource) #controller {
        display: none !important;
        visibility: hidden !important;
        opacity: 0 !important;
      }
      
      /* Override hiding for manual controllers (unless explicitly hidden) */
      :host(.vsc-manual:not(.vsc-hidden)) #controller {
        display: block !important;
        visibility: visible !important;
        opacity: 0.3 !important;
      }
      
      /* Show shadow DOM content when host has vsc-show class (highest priority) */
      :host(.vsc-show) #controller {
        display: block !important;
        visibility: visible !important;
        opacity: 0.3 !important;
      }
      
      #controller {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        background: black;
        color: white;
        border-radius: 6px;
        padding: 4px;
        margin: 10px 10px 10px 15px;
        cursor: default;
        z-index: 9999999;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      
      #controller:hover {
        opacity: 0.7;
      }
      
      #controller:hover>.draggable {
        margin-right: 0.8em;
      }
      
      #controls {
        display: none;
        vertical-align: middle;
      }
      
      #controller.dragging {
        cursor: -webkit-grabbing;
        opacity: 0.7;
      }
      
      #controller.dragging #controls {
        display: inline-block;
      }
      
      .draggable {
        cursor: -webkit-grab;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 2.8em;
        height: 1.4em;
        text-align: center;
        vertical-align: middle;
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }
      
      .draggable:active {
        cursor: -webkit-grabbing;
      }
      
      button {
        opacity: 1;
        cursor: pointer;
        color: black;
        background: white;
        font-weight: normal;
        border-radius: 5px;
        padding: 1px 5px 3px 5px;
        font-size: inherit;
        line-height: inherit;
        border: 0px solid white;
        font-family: "Lucida Console", Monaco, monospace;
        margin: 0px 2px 2px 2px;
        transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s;
      }
      
      button:focus {
        outline: 0;
      }
      
      button:hover {
        opacity: 1;
        background: #2196f3;
        color: #ffffff;
      }
      
      button:active {
        background: #2196f3;
        color: #ffffff;
        font-weight: bold;
      }
      
      button.rw {
        opacity: 0.65;
      }
      
      button.hideButton {
        opacity: 0.65;
        margin-left: 8px;
        margin-right: 2px;
      }

class="markdown prose dark:prose-invert w-full wrap-break-word dark markdown-new-styling"><h2 data-start="0" data-end="34">TL;DR (High-Utility Core Rules)</h2>
<ul data-start="36" data-end="398">
<li data-start="36" data-end="177">
<p data-start="38" data-end="177"><strong data-start="38" data-end="45">Do:</strong> Think long-term, act consistently, learn continuously, manage energy (not just time), build relationships, and reflect regularly.</p>
</li>
<li data-start="178" data-end="296">
<p data-start="180" data-end="296"><strong data-start="180" data-end="190">Don’t:</strong> Chase short-term validation, ignore health, avoid discomfort, burn bridges, or drift without direction.</p>
</li>
<li data-start="297" data-end="398">
<p data-start="299" data-end="398"><strong data-start="299" data-end="313">Meta-rule:</strong> <em data-start="314" data-end="398">Your systems (habits, environment, thinking patterns) matter more than your goals.</em></p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="400" data-end="403">
<h1 data-start="405" data-end="465">🧭 UNIVERSAL LIFE OPERATING SYSTEM (Step-by-Step, Layered)</h1>
<hr data-start="467" data-end="470">
<h1 data-start="472" data-end="506">1. 🧠 THINKING &amp; DECISION-MAKING</h1>
<h2 data-start="508" data-end="515">✅ DO</h2>
<h3 data-start="516" data-end="549">1.1 First-Principles Thinking</h3>
<ul data-start="550" data-end="712">
<li data-start="550" data-end="662">
<p data-start="552" data-end="583">Break problems to fundamentals:</p>
<ul data-start="586" data-end="662">
<li data-start="586" data-end="625">
<p data-start="588" data-end="625">What is <strong data-start="596" data-end="613">actually true</strong> vs assumed?</p>
</li>
<li data-start="628" data-end="662">
<p data-start="630" data-end="662">What are constraints vs beliefs?</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-start="663" data-end="712">
<p data-start="665" data-end="712">Avoid copying blindly (career, trends, advice).</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="714" data-end="743">1.2 Second-Order Thinking</h3>
<ul data-start="744" data-end="821">
<li data-start="744" data-end="821">
<p data-start="746" data-end="750">Ask:</p>
<ul data-start="753" data-end="821">
<li data-start="753" data-end="781">
<p data-start="755" data-end="781">“What happens after this?”</p>
</li>
<li data-start="784" data-end="821">
<p data-start="786" data-end="821">“What are unintended consequences?”</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="823" data-end="853">1.3 Probabilistic Thinking</h3>
<ul data-start="854" data-end="967">
<li data-start="854" data-end="967">
<p data-start="856" data-end="898">Think in <strong data-start="865" data-end="880">likelihoods</strong>, not certainties:</p>
<ul data-start="901" data-end="967">
<li data-start="901" data-end="923">
<p data-start="903" data-end="923">Not “this will work”</p>
</li>
<li data-start="926" data-end="967">
<p data-start="928" data-end="967">But “this has 70% chance, worth trying”</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="969" data-end="991">1.4 Decision Loops</h3>
<ul data-start="992" data-end="1061">
<li data-start="992" data-end="1061">
<p data-start="994" data-end="1004">Use cycle:</p>
<ul data-start="1007" data-end="1061">
<li data-start="1007" data-end="1061">
<p data-start="1009" data-end="1061">Observe → Analyze → Decide → Act → Reflect → Iterate</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="1063" data-end="1066">
<h2 data-start="1068" data-end="1078">❌ DON’T</h2>
<ul data-start="1079" data-end="1260">
<li data-start="1079" data-end="1119">
<p data-start="1081" data-end="1119">Think in absolutes (“always”, “never”)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1120" data-end="1156">
<p data-start="1122" data-end="1156">Outsource thinking to social media</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1157" data-end="1212">
<p data-start="1159" data-end="1212">Make emotional decisions during high emotional states</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1213" data-end="1260">
<p data-start="1215" data-end="1260">Overthink without action (analysis paralysis)</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="1262" data-end="1265">
<h1 data-start="1267" data-end="1293">2. ⚙️ ACTION &amp; EXECUTION</h1>
<h2 data-start="1295" data-end="1302">✅ DO</h2>
<h3 data-start="1303" data-end="1329">2.1 Bias Toward Action</h3>
<ul data-start="1330" data-end="1388">
<li data-start="1330" data-end="1355">
<p data-start="1332" data-end="1355">Action &gt; overplanning</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1356" data-end="1388">
<p data-start="1358" data-end="1388">Small steps compound massively</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="1390" data-end="1419">2.2 Build Systems &gt; Goals</h3>
<ul data-start="1420" data-end="1472">
<li data-start="1420" data-end="1441">
<p data-start="1422" data-end="1441">Goals = direction</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1442" data-end="1472">
<p data-start="1444" data-end="1472">Systems = execution engine</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1474" data-end="1482">Example:</p>
<ul data-start="1483" data-end="1541">
<li data-start="1483" data-end="1500">
<p data-start="1485" data-end="1500">Goal: “Get fit”</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1501" data-end="1541">
<p data-start="1503" data-end="1541">System: “Workout 30 min daily at 7 AM”</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="1543" data-end="1574">2.3 Consistency &gt; Intensity</h3>
<ul data-start="1575" data-end="1624">
<li data-start="1575" data-end="1624">
<p data-start="1577" data-end="1624">1% improvement daily beats bursts of motivation</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="1626" data-end="1629">
<h2 data-start="1631" data-end="1641">❌ DON’T</h2>
<ul data-start="1642" data-end="1760">
<li data-start="1642" data-end="1680">
<p data-start="1644" data-end="1680">Depend on motivation (it’s unstable)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1681" data-end="1716">
<p data-start="1683" data-end="1716">Start too big → leads to quitting</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1717" data-end="1760">
<p data-start="1719" data-end="1760">Chase novelty instead of finishing things</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="1762" data-end="1765">
<h1 data-start="1767" data-end="1800">3. 🧍 HEALTH (FOUNDATION LAYER)</h1>
<h2 data-start="1802" data-end="1809">✅ DO</h2>
<h3 data-start="1810" data-end="1833">3.1 Physical Health</h3>
<ul data-start="1834" data-end="1963">
<li data-start="1834" data-end="1869">
<p data-start="1836" data-end="1869">Sleep: 7–8 hours (non-negotiable)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1870" data-end="1914">
<p data-start="1872" data-end="1881">Exercise:</p>
<ul data-start="1884" data-end="1914">
<li data-start="1884" data-end="1914">
<p data-start="1886" data-end="1914">Strength + cardio + mobility</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-start="1915" data-end="1963">
<p data-start="1917" data-end="1927">Nutrition:</p>
<ul data-start="1930" data-end="1963">
<li data-start="1930" data-end="1963">
<p data-start="1932" data-end="1963">Protein, whole foods, hydration</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="1965" data-end="1986">3.2 Mental Health</h3>
<ul data-start="1987" data-end="2117">
<li data-start="1987" data-end="2053">
<p data-start="1989" data-end="1998">Practice:</p>
<ul data-start="2001" data-end="2053">
<li data-start="2001" data-end="2026">
<p data-start="2003" data-end="2026">Reflection (journaling)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2029" data-end="2053">
<p data-start="2031" data-end="2053">Stillness (meditation)</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-start="2054" data-end="2117">
<p data-start="2056" data-end="2062">Limit:</p>
<ul data-start="2065" data-end="2117">
<li data-start="2065" data-end="2117">
<p data-start="2067" data-end="2117">Dopamine overload (constant scrolling, junk input)</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="2119" data-end="2122">
<h2 data-start="2124" data-end="2134">❌ DON’T</h2>
<ul data-start="2135" data-end="2257">
<li data-start="2135" data-end="2175">
<p data-start="2137" data-end="2175">Trade sleep for productivity long-term</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2176" data-end="2207">
<p data-start="2178" data-end="2207">Ignore early signs of burnout</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2208" data-end="2257">
<p data-start="2210" data-end="2257">Use escapism (addictions, constant distraction)</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="2259" data-end="2262">
<h1 data-start="2264" data-end="2286">4. 💰 MONEY &amp; CAREER</h1>
<h2 data-start="2288" data-end="2295">✅ DO</h2>
<h3 data-start="2296" data-end="2318">4.1 Skill Stacking</h3>
<ul data-start="2319" data-end="2423">
<li data-start="2319" data-end="2423">
<p data-start="2321" data-end="2329">Combine:</p>
<ul data-start="2332" data-end="2423">
<li data-start="2332" data-end="2371">
<p data-start="2334" data-end="2371">Core skill (coding, business, design)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2374" data-end="2391">
<ul data-start="2376" data-end="2391">
<li data-start="2376" data-end="2391">
<p data-start="2378" data-end="2391">communication</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-start="2394" data-end="2423">
<ul data-start="2396" data-end="2423">
<li data-start="2396" data-end="2423">
<p data-start="2398" data-end="2423">leverage (tech, internet)</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="2425" data-end="2457">4.2 Long-Term Value Creation</h3>
<ul data-start="2458" data-end="2548">
<li data-start="2458" data-end="2548">
<p data-start="2460" data-end="2469">Focus on:</p>
<ul data-start="2472" data-end="2548">
<li data-start="2472" data-end="2495">
<p data-start="2474" data-end="2495">Solving real problems</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2498" data-end="2548">
<p data-start="2500" data-end="2548">Creating assets (skills, content, code, network)</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="2550" data-end="2578">4.3 Financial Discipline</h3>
<ul data-start="2579" data-end="2628">
<li data-start="2579" data-end="2600">
<p data-start="2581" data-end="2600">Save + invest early</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2601" data-end="2628">
<p data-start="2603" data-end="2628">Avoid lifestyle inflation</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="2630" data-end="2633">
<h2 data-start="2635" data-end="2645">❌ DON’T</h2>
<ul data-start="2646" data-end="2750">
<li data-start="2646" data-end="2683">
<p data-start="2648" data-end="2683">Chase only salary → ignore learning</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2684" data-end="2716">
<p data-start="2686" data-end="2716">Depend on single income stream</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2717" data-end="2750">
<p data-start="2719" data-end="2750">Compare your timeline to others</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="2752" data-end="2755">
<h1 data-start="2757" data-end="2793">5. 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 RELATIONSHIPS &amp; SOCIAL</h1>
<h2 data-start="2795" data-end="2802">✅ DO</h2>
<h3 data-start="2803" data-end="2822">5.1 Be Reliable</h3>
<ul data-start="2823" data-end="2863">
<li data-start="2823" data-end="2863">
<p data-start="2825" data-end="2863">Do what you say → builds trust capital</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="2865" data-end="2892">5.2 Communicate Clearly</h3>
<ul data-start="2893" data-end="2926">
<li data-start="2893" data-end="2926">
<p data-start="2895" data-end="2926">Say what you mean, respectfully</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="2928" data-end="2964">5.3 Choose Environment Carefully</h3>
<ul data-start="2965" data-end="3023">
<li data-start="2965" data-end="3023">
<p data-start="2967" data-end="2983">You become your:</p>
<ul data-start="2986" data-end="3023">
<li data-start="2986" data-end="2995">
<p data-start="2988" data-end="2995">Friends</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2998" data-end="3006">
<p data-start="3000" data-end="3006">Inputs</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3009" data-end="3023">
<p data-start="3011" data-end="3023">Surroundings</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="3025" data-end="3028">
<h2 data-start="3030" data-end="3040">❌ DON’T</h2>
<ul data-start="3041" data-end="3141">
<li data-start="3041" data-end="3072">
<p data-start="3043" data-end="3072">Burn bridges (world is small)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3073" data-end="3110">
<p data-start="3075" data-end="3110">Stay in toxic environments too long</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3111" data-end="3141">
<p data-start="3113" data-end="3141">Seek validation over respect</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="3143" data-end="3146">
<h1 data-start="3148" data-end="3181">6. 🧭 IDENTITY &amp; SELF-DIRECTION</h1>
<h2 data-start="3183" data-end="3190">✅ DO</h2>
<h3 data-start="3191" data-end="3215">6.1 Know Your Values</h3>
<ul data-start="3216" data-end="3271">
<li data-start="3216" data-end="3271">
<p data-start="3218" data-end="3225">Define:</p>
<ul data-start="3228" data-end="3271">
<li data-start="3228" data-end="3243">
<p data-start="3230" data-end="3243">What matters?</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3246" data-end="3271">
<p data-start="3248" data-end="3271">What is non-negotiable?</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="3273" data-end="3297">6.2 Build Self-Trust</h3>
<ul data-start="3298" data-end="3325">
<li data-start="3298" data-end="3325">
<p data-start="3300" data-end="3325">Keep promises to yourself</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="3327" data-end="3354">6.3 Periodic Life Audit</h3>
<ul data-start="3355" data-end="3430">
<li data-start="3355" data-end="3430">
<p data-start="3357" data-end="3374">Every 3–6 months:</p>
<ul data-start="3377" data-end="3430">
<li data-start="3377" data-end="3394">
<p data-start="3379" data-end="3394">What’s working?</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3397" data-end="3410">
<p data-start="3399" data-end="3410">What’s not?</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3413" data-end="3430">
<p data-start="3415" data-end="3430">What to change?</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="3432" data-end="3435">
<h2 data-start="3437" data-end="3447">❌ DON’T</h2>
<ul data-start="3448" data-end="3543">
<li data-start="3448" data-end="3473">
<p data-start="3450" data-end="3473">Drift without intention</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3474" data-end="3507">
<p data-start="3476" data-end="3507">Copy others’ life paths blindly</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3508" data-end="3543">
<p data-start="3510" data-end="3543">Tie identity to external outcomes</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="3545" data-end="3548">
<h1 data-start="3550" data-end="3575">7. 📚 LEARNING &amp; GROWTH</h1>
<h2 data-start="3577" data-end="3584">✅ DO</h2>
<h3 data-start="3585" data-end="3611">7.1 Learn How to Learn</h3>
<ul data-start="3612" data-end="3665">
<li data-start="3612" data-end="3627">
<p data-start="3614" data-end="3627">Active recall</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3628" data-end="3647">
<p data-start="3630" data-end="3647">Spaced repetition</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3648" data-end="3665">
<p data-start="3650" data-end="3665">Teaching others</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="3667" data-end="3689">7.2 Feedback Loops</h3>
<ul data-start="3690" data-end="3730">
<li data-start="3690" data-end="3730">
<p data-start="3692" data-end="3697">Seek:</p>
<ul data-start="3700" data-end="3730">
<li data-start="3700" data-end="3711">
<p data-start="3702" data-end="3711">Criticism</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3714" data-end="3730">
<p data-start="3716" data-end="3730">Reality checks</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="3732" data-end="3763">7.3 Experimentation Mindset</h3>
<ul data-start="3764" data-end="3818">
<li data-start="3764" data-end="3818">
<p data-start="3766" data-end="3782">Treat life like:</p>
<ul data-start="3785" data-end="3818">
<li data-start="3785" data-end="3818">
<p data-start="3787" data-end="3818">Iterations, not final decisions</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="3820" data-end="3823">
<h2 data-start="3825" data-end="3835">❌ DON’T</h2>
<ul data-start="3836" data-end="3913">
<li data-start="3836" data-end="3858">
<p data-start="3838" data-end="3858">Stay in comfort zone</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3859" data-end="3886">
<p data-start="3861" data-end="3886">Avoid failure → it's data</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3887" data-end="3913">
<p data-start="3889" data-end="3913">Consume without applying</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="3915" data-end="3918">
<h1 data-start="3920" data-end="3952">8. ⚖️ TIME &amp; ENERGY MANAGEMENT</h1>
<h2 data-start="3954" data-end="3961">✅ DO</h2>
<h3 data-start="3962" data-end="3983">8.1 Energy &gt; Time</h3>
<ul data-start="3984" data-end="4053">
<li data-start="3984" data-end="4021">
<p data-start="3986" data-end="3992">Track:</p>
<ul data-start="3995" data-end="4021">
<li data-start="3995" data-end="4021">
<p data-start="3997" data-end="4021">When you're most focused</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-start="4022" data-end="4053">
<p data-start="4024" data-end="4053">Schedule important work there</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="4055" data-end="4072">8.2 Deep Work</h3>
<ul data-start="4073" data-end="4118">
<li data-start="4073" data-end="4118">
<p data-start="4075" data-end="4118">Focus without distractions (1–3 hrs blocks)</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="4120" data-end="4153">8.3 Eliminate Low-Value Tasks</h3>
<ul data-start="4154" data-end="4175">
<li data-start="4154" data-end="4175">
<p data-start="4156" data-end="4175">Say “no” more often</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="4177" data-end="4180">
<h2 data-start="4182" data-end="4192">❌ DON’T</h2>
<ul data-start="4193" data-end="4265">
<li data-start="4193" data-end="4222">
<p data-start="4195" data-end="4222">Multitask (reduces quality)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4223" data-end="4252">
<p data-start="4225" data-end="4252">Fill time with shallow work</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4253" data-end="4265">
<p data-start="4255" data-end="4265">Overcommit</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="4267" data-end="4270">
<h1 data-start="4272" data-end="4308">9. 🌍 REALITY CHECKS (HARD TRUTHS)</h1>
<h2 data-start="4310" data-end="4332">Accept These Early:</h2>
<ul data-start="4333" data-end="4499">
<li data-start="4333" data-end="4373">
<p data-start="4335" data-end="4373">Life is unfair → adapt, don’t complain</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4374" data-end="4404">
<p data-start="4376" data-end="4404">Nobody is coming to save you</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4405" data-end="4428">
<p data-start="4407" data-end="4428">You will fail → often</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4429" data-end="4454">
<p data-start="4431" data-end="4454">Discipline &gt; motivation</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4455" data-end="4499">
<p data-start="4457" data-end="4499">Luck matters → but preparation attracts it</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="4501" data-end="4504">
<h1 data-start="4506" data-end="4542">10. 🔁 META-RULES (MOST IMPORTANT)</h1>
<h2 data-start="4544" data-end="4567">10.1 Compounding Law</h2>
<ul data-start="4568" data-end="4609">
<li data-start="4568" data-end="4609">
<p data-start="4570" data-end="4609">Small actions × time = massive outcomes</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 data-start="4611" data-end="4637">10.2 Inversion Thinking</h2>
<ul data-start="4638" data-end="4704">
<li data-start="4638" data-end="4668">
<p data-start="4640" data-end="4668">Instead of “how to succeed?”</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4669" data-end="4704">
<p data-start="4671" data-end="4704">Ask: “how to fail?” → avoid those</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 data-start="4706" data-end="4732">10.3 Environment Design</h2>
<ul data-start="4733" data-end="4779">
<li data-start="4733" data-end="4756">
<p data-start="4735" data-end="4756">Make good habits easy</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4757" data-end="4779">
<p data-start="4759" data-end="4779">Make bad habits hard</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="4781" data-end="4784">
<h1 data-start="4786" data-end="4825">🧩 SIMPLE DAILY TEMPLATE (APPLY THIS)</h1>
<ul data-start="4827" data-end="4988">
<li data-start="4827" data-end="4854">

</li>
<li data-start="4855" data-end="4885">
<p data-start="4857" data-end="4885"><strong data-start="4857" data-end="4866">Mind:</strong> Learn (study/read)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4886" data-end="4919">
<p data-start="4888" data-end="4919"><strong data-start="4888" data-end="4897">Work:</strong> Build (skill/project)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4920" data-end="4959">
<p data-start="4922" data-end="4959"><strong data-start="4922" data-end="4933">System:</strong> Improve (optimize habits)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4960" data-end="4988">
<p data-start="4962" data-end="4988"><strong data-start="4962" data-end="4977">Reflection:</strong> Review day</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="4990" data-end="4993">
<h1 data-start="4995" data-end="5021">FINAL TL;DR (Compressed)</h1>
<ul data-start="5023" data-end="5218">
<li data-start="5023" data-end="5079">
<p data-start="5025" data-end="5079">Think clearly → Act consistently → Reflect regularly</p>
</li>
<li data-start="5080" data-end="5127">
<p data-start="5082" data-end="5127">Health, skills, relationships = core assets</p>
</li>
<li data-start="5128" data-end="5152">
<p data-start="5130" data-end="5152">Systems &gt; motivation</p>
</li>
<li data-start="5153" data-end="5191">
<p data-start="5155" data-end="5191">Avoid stupidity &gt; chase brilliance</p>
</li>
<li data-start="5192" data-end="5218">
<p data-start="5194" data-end="5218">Long-term &gt; short-term</p>
</li>
</ul>
